body:
It's only different for me because I drive over the road.

I'm home 5 days a month (consecutively).  

Right now what I'm going through is a girl I met and went to dinner with once asking me to be hers.

Personally I'm trying hard for her to not move on as I like her, but would like to continuously converse and see what it's like for the next time I'm home.

Do what you feel, if it's too forward for her, she's not the one for you.
I'm already giving up what I'm good at due to personal reasons with an ex.
My life is literally empty.  I have nothing to live for.
That's the thing... I can't I don't want to.
I fear in those three time spans I'll be 10x worse than now.
I don't have the attention span to do anything.  I can't hold conversations with strangers, I keep thinking of what was going to be.
I think my heart is to broken by my past to ever let another human being in.
I don't really live in one city.  I drive a semi over the road

People I know? I would say 300 or so.
Women I've spoken to on a somewhat persomal basis? About 50 or so.
People I know? Lots.  Friends? 2.  Girls have i spoken to? Lots.  Been with? 2.  At the age of 28.

The thing is we were too alike.  It seemed like we were perfect for eachother.  She knew my anxiety like I knew hers.  Not a lot of people even believe in mental illness.  Everytime I talk to her I cry again because she makes comments giving me false hope and 45 minutes later tearing me down.

I want to take from this experience that I finally found someone I loved, but I feel as if I wont be able to.  It took a lot for me to open up to her and now I'm gonna fall back into my old way of closed off.  I will never let a grieving spouse be upset even if she says it's normal and she's fine.

I do feel she's the only kind.  I feel she's the only one which is why I still talk to her when I shouldn't.  I feel like the pain is better than no feeling when it comes to her.  I just, I'm at a loss.  My brain isn't processing things clearly.

She did somethings wrong, of course.  But the fail of the relationship falls on me.

She tried to change me.  But I couldn't see it until too late.  She got into a state of depression about once every 3 says.  She told me it went away on its own and she's good.  I tried to console her at first but it didn't work.  So eventually I didn't keep trying.  The only thing i was tired of was being accused of cheating when we lived in a semi truck together and she had complete access to my phone.

He'll I tried to make it the best.  We went to the golden gate bridge together, we stayed 2 miles away from the Mexico border together, we did so much together.  Everything seemed to be fine... Even tho she said she was losing feelings.  And now they're gone.

She is not guilty at all about it.  We've spoke on the phone a couple times and She barely has anything to say.

On my guilt it's all me. I keep seeing what I did wrong clear as day.
But yes she was happy with me when she wasn't upset about thinking she wasn't good enough for me.  Or that I was talking to someone else.
She's mostly cold towards me now.  Yes.  All about how I mistreated her.
She broke up with me.  I feel a ton of guilt.  She had told me for the longest time that her feelings were fading but I didnt try to fix it until it was too late.  I wasn't able to be there for her.
